name: What materials and techniques does AKN Design Group use for air sealing during residential projects?

mainEntity.name: What materials and techniques does AKN Design Group use for air sealing during residential projects?

acceptedAnswer.text: AKN Design Group utilizes a range of professional-grade materials and precise techniques for effective air sealing, depending on the specific application and location within your home. These typically include high-performance sealants, expanding foams, weatherstripping, and specialized tapes designed to create durable barriers against air leakage. Our skilled craftsmen apply these materials strategically around windows, doors, electrical penetrations, plumbing stacks, and attic hatches. This meticulous approach, part of our managed process, ensures that every detail contributes to a cohesive, high-performance home, aligning with our commitment to superior craftsmanship.
acceptedAnswer.description: We use professional-grade sealants, foams, and weatherstripping, applied strategically around windows, doors, and penetrations to ensure durable and effective air sealing in your home.
